GP leakage/gain/reverse/Early/high-injection, constant100pF BC caps, direct interstage bias and feedback, explicit sourceR. No imposed4.5V offset.
assets.behavior: Healthy Fuzz/Volume, Q1 BC leakage7.546u->75.46u variation and feedback100k->10k wrong part. 4x with stopped preparation, bounded24Newton updates, explicit failure counters. Raw-relative plus RMS-matched WAVs.
limitations: Untrimmed nominal fitted sample gives Q2collector-7.55V and about1.05kOhm input impedance at1kHz, differing from common4.5V/5..8k targets. Independent equation/solver validation is not physical-pedal calibration.

Finite-range measured fit: no terminal series resistance, nonlinear junction charge/storage, breakdown/noise, temperature evolution, battery impedance or full pickup/cable model.1x8.8kHz .05V diagnostic can leave guardedjunctiondomain; rejected, not used as alias evidence or listening material.
